lines.text: Flour rises in a beam of light as @maya_front pulls a golden loaf from the oven and taps its base.
Close on the tap; hear the hollow sound.

new_beats.text: @maya_front smiles, satisfied, and lifts the loaf to her ear.

writes.note: I added a beat where she smiles and listens to the loaf after the tap.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a reaction after the tap, so one short moment at 2 s shows her satisfaction without changing the existing words.
